I farm here in Singida, and the rains are not reliable like in Mbeya or the north. This plot I grow mixed — sunflower with some sorghum and cowpea between — because if one fails the other may give something. I have little cash this year, so I will not buy fertilizer from the shop; last season I saw my neighbor put DAP on his sunflower and the rain stopped early, so his money was wasted. I will spread the kraal manure I have from my few goats, use the seed I saved from last harvest, and weed with my wife and the children — only at planting time I will call two people to help me finish before the rain passes.
